summary: Nimbus project management dashboard displaying weekly metrics, quick navigation, and recent project progress with statuses and owners.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router)
stack.why: Provides React frontend, API routes, and easy static/server hybrid rendering in a single repository.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Allows rapid layout composition and exact replication of design tokens like custom slate and indigo shades.

stack.name: PostgreSQL via Supabase
stack.why: Managed relational database with instant REST/GraphQL endpoints and built-in authentication.

stack.name: Supabase Auth
stack.why: Handles session management, user profiles, and row-level security easily for team projects.

stack.name: Vercel
stack.why: Zero-configuration deployment platform tailored for Next.js full-stack applications.

steps.check: Run npm run dev and confirm Tailwind compiles properly.

steps.title: Construct the App Layout with Sidebar
steps.detail: Build components/Sidebar.tsx with the Nimbus gradient logo, main navigation links (Dashboard, Projects, My tasks, Reports, Team), and bottom items (Settings, Log out).
steps.check: Ensure sidebar stretches full height with dark background.

steps.title: Create Header and Top Controls
steps.detail: Implement components/Header.tsx with a search input field, empty notifications icon container, and golden circular avatar with initials 'AK'.
steps.check: Verify search bar focuses and avatar renders correctly.

steps.title: Implement Metric Cards Grid
steps.detail: Develop components/MetricCard.tsx and render four cards: Active projects, Tasks due this week, Completed, and Team members with subtext stats in green.
steps.check: Metrics grid shows 4 equal-width responsive columns on desktop.

steps.title: Build Recent Projects Table Component
steps.detail: Create components/RecentProjectsTable.tsx with headers PROJECT, OWNER, PROGRESS, STATUS, DUE, including progress bars and status pills.
steps.check: Table displays rows matching screenshot with appropriate badge styles.

steps.title: Set Up Database Schema in Supabase
steps.detail: Write SQL migration scripts creating projects, tasks, and users tables to store project progress, status, and assignment data.
steps.code:
CREATE TABLE projects (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  progress INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (progress >= 0 AND progress <= 100),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('On track', 'At risk', 'Blocked')),
  due_date DATE NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
steps.check: Tables created and seeded with 4 mock project rows.

steps.title: Create Dashboard API Endpoint
steps.detail: Add app/api/dashboard/route.ts returning aggregated metrics along with the 4 most recent projects ordered by created_at.

steps.title: Wire Data to Page and Add '+ New project' Action
steps.detail: Fetch data in app/page.tsx, pass it to cards and table, and handle clicking the '+ New project' button with a modal trigger.

backend.database: Supabase (PostgreSQL) for managed relational storage and relational integrity.
backend.auth: Supabase JWT session stored in httpOnly cookies, verified on each API route and server component.

endpoints.purpose: Returns summary counts and recent projects list.
Returns paginated list of all projects.

rules: Progress must be an integer between 0 and 100
Status must strictly be one of: 'On track', 'At risk', or 'Blocked'

pitfalls: Hardcoding progress bar fill styles instead of using dynamic CSS width percentage (e.g. style={{ width: `${progress}%` }})
Failing to constrain the progress value between 0 and 100 which could overflow the bar container
Setting fixed column widths in the table causing horizontal scrolling on medium screens instead of responsive fluid widths
testing: Verify MetricCard displays positive trend indicators with green text
Verify RecentProjectsTable renders correct badge color corresponding to each status
Verify search filter accurately hides non-matching project rows
Check responsiveness on viewports smaller than 1024px to ensure sidebar gracefully hides or toggles
deploy: Create a Supabase project and run initial database migrations
Link Github repository to Vercel and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variables
Trigger production build and deployment via Vercel

tokens.method: Colours: pixel quantisation of the whole screenshot and of each detected element. Font sizes: text box height ÷ 1.25. Spacing: gaps between sibling boxes, snapped to a 4px grid. Measured approximations, not values read from source code.
